question: Which organisation is responsible for the development and maintenance of the roads on the Indian borders?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Border Roads Organisation.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is **option 1**, i.e., Border Roads Organisation (BRO), which is responsible for the **development and maintenance** of roads on the **Indian borders.**
 
• BRO is a **leading road construction agency** under the** Ministry of Defence **that was formed in** 1960.**
